top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a distinct device concept (magic-wavelength optical lattice), a decisive realisation at the 10^-18 level, independent reproduction in several national laboratories, and a clean two-name allocation with no predictor or co-discoverer left obviously outside. The citation is confined to the lattice clock, which keeps it apart from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. P002 is scientifically sound and ranked second, but the omission of Bernevig and Hughes, who made the HgTe prediction that Molenkamp tested, and of the 3D work would be hard to defend. No award is ranked last because at least one mature, well-attributed proposal exists.
